name: Scale slider
summary: A rating scale on the audience phone: slider, end labels and a live readout using the product's own label rules, coloured by the statement's deck palette position.
highlights: Rating scale with end labels and a readout
Accent by the statement's palette position
Native range input: keyboard and slider role built in
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-scale-slider> — for the audience phone of a slide type (a cross-origin iframe on the Developer Platform). Framework-free, loaded by URL from the version-pinned CDN with tokens.css, so a build-less page imports it instead of copying CSS. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) binds events through a ref; Vue binds the custom element natively.

spec.label: Readout
spec.value: 16px above the rail: "value: label", the label semibold

spec.label: Rail
spec.value: 8px, ink at 10% with the 1px ink hairline; the filled part keeps the same hairline

spec.label: Handle
spec.value: 24px white disc with a 4px accent ring, 44px tall hit area

spec.label: Ends
spec.value: 14px low label left, high label right, each wrapping in its own half

props.name: ink
props.desc: The deck ink (xprops.slide.textColour) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: accent
props.desc: The deck accent (presentationColorPalette[0]) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: lock-key
props.desc: The submission-lock key for this question: once a submission is locked under it, the element locks and restores the submitted value, including after an iframe remount

props.name: value / min / max / step
props.desc: The scale. `value` is also a property

props.name: low-label / high-label
props.desc: What the two ends are called (translated)

props.name: step-labels
props.desc: Names for the positions between the ends; ignored past 10 steps

props.name: unset / unset-hint
props.desc: No value chosen yet: a live handle, but no number and no fill; the hint shows under the handle

props.name: commit-on-drag
props.desc: A bare tap only previews; change fires on release after a real drag, or on a key

props.name: change
props.desc: Fires when a value is committed

whenToUse.when: a rating on a numeric scale tied to a statement
a handful of named choices rather than a scale

opinion.note: Pass `accent` from presentationColorPalette by the statement's position, so each row keeps the colour the canvas gives it. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.
